basic_info.description: Available for the first time in nearly 70 yrs, this stately Marina 3-story residence is an opportunity to own a legacy property with scale, character, and potential. Rich w/original detail, it features 3 spacious bedrooms, 2 full baths, 2 half-baths, and a large lower level room with direct access to garden. You enter the home into a large foyer and expansive formal living and dining rooms. The east-facing kitchen and adjacent breakfast room open onto a deck overlooking the deep, private garden. A powder room & interior stair access to the garden level room complete this floor. On the top floor is a serene  primary suite flooded with natural light, a classic ensuite dressing room and adjoining bathroom. This floor has 2 add'l generously sized bedrooms with garden views. An additional full bath completes this floor. On the garden level is a large room with ensuite 1/2 bath and direct garden access, currently staged as a family room/office.  A laundry closet completes this level. Garage can accommodate a large car/SUV & has a separate storage room. This home is located steps from Marina Green & Fort Mason offering the perfect balance of city life & relaxing outdoor living. A special family home awaiting its next chapter.
